role_separation: Registrar is independent of picture raters, blind to outcomes, and never receives picture boxes or derived labels.
permitted_inputs: EVT locus headers and reading-specific block line counts
coordinates: Native canvas pixels, x/y/width/height; record actual displayed raster dimensions and transformation to native canvas.
count_rule: Do not force a match: a block whose visible count does not match the EVT unit is UNREGISTERED and dropped under the spec. Preserve every dropped block and H/F discrepancy.
release_rule: This contract does not establish blinding. Record registrar identity, exposure declaration and exact inputs actually received. Hash the completed geometry before deriving labels.
